function.name: bash
function.description: Run shell commands in the persistent virtual /workspace. Supports ls, cat, grep, sed, awk, jq, pipes and redirects. No network, Python, Node, npm or native binaries.

function.name: read
function.description: Read a workspace UTF-8 file. Inspect files before editing.

function.name: write
function.description: Create or replace a UTF-8 file. HTML files appear in the artifact panel. Use self-contained HTML, inline CSS/JS, no CDN.

function.name: glob
function.description: Find virtual workspace files by glob pattern (*, **, ?, character classes), e.g. **/*.html. Returns sorted paths. No host filesystem.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search virtual file contents with a regular expression (or literal=true). Returns path:line:match. Recursive under path; optional glob filters files.

function.name: edit
function.description: Replace exactly one occurrence in a file. Read the file first.

function.name: present_ui
function.description: Display an interactive card in the chat. Always include type, title, summary and data. Choose only the data fields for your type: checklist/timeline use items; comparison uses columns+rows; chart uses kind+labels+series; parameters uses controls+outputs; diagram uses nodes+edges. Provide 2-6 real items. After success respond briefly without repeating the card.

data.description: REQUIRED. Fill the matching fields below with actual data.

values.description: Column key to string or number value

expr.description: Calculation AST: a number, {param:"control_id"}, or {op:"add|sub|mul|div|if|range|map|sum|avg",args:[expressions]}. Example {op:"mul",args:[{param:"price"},{param:"count"}]}. map binds {var:"x"}.

chart.description: Optional calculated chart {kind:"line",series:[{id,label,expr}]} where expr produces an array, e.g. {op:"map",args:[{op:"range",args:[1,12,1]},{op:"mul",args:[{var:"x"},{param:"price"}]}]}

function.name: update_ui_state
function.description: Update an existing card using its id and version. patch flat keys: selected; checked:item-id (boolean); visible:series-id (boolean); param:control-id. Same-field concurrent changes return a conflict.

function.name: get_datetime
function.description: Return the current local date and time.

prefix-speed-0-cold.content: KV cache 是一个缓存机制，用于快速地访问和更新数据。当用户访问一个资源时，系统会检查现有的缓存，如果存在就返回，如果不存在就向服务器发送请求。

methodology: Apple M5 Pro, Chromium, context 131072, KV INT4 g32, greedy, ngram disabled. Seven alternating pairs, active KV reset before each generation. Cold disables pinned prefix cache; pinned restores the same 1216-token system prefix. max_tokens=64, actual completions=43. Disk refresh is one first-generation sample after reloading Worker; model load time is excluded from TTFT.
